title: eupatorium wallichii var. heterophyllum
intro: Eupatorium wallichii var. heterophyllum, commonly known as Himalayan feverfew, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing fever, alleviating inflammation, and acting as an antispasmodic. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan feverfew include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
